readings.label: Upload usage
readings.value: 100% used by an 8 GB video upload to NusaDrive

note.text: Maya: my meeting audio keeps breaking up, a friend says the office network is under attack!

explanation: Pings to the router and the internet are fast with no lost packets, but the upload path is fully used by an 8 GB video upload during the video meeting. Guide Maya to pause the upload until the meeting ends.
hints: Trust numbers, not rumors. Do the ping results show a network problem?
Look at what is using the upload path during the meeting. Does anything need fixing?
